The most severe note (3746332, CVE-2026-44748) is an XML Signature Wrapping SAML flaw allowing authentication bypass.
A kernel memory corruption in the AS ABAP RFC kernel (Note 3717897, CVE-2026-27671) is rated CVSS 9.8 and requires a kernel patch with no workaround.

evidence.quote: SAP's June 9, 2026 Security Patch Day published 15 new security notes, several at near-maximum severity against core NetWeaver and ABAP platform components, with the headline note rated CVSS 9.9.

The most severe item, Note 3746332 (CVE-2026-44748), is an XML Signature Wrapping flaw in SAML authentication that can let an attacker forge a valid authentication assertion and bypass login controls.
Close behind is SAP Security Note 3717897, CVE-2026-27671, a memory corruption vulnerability in the Application Server ABAP RFC kernel, rated CVSS 9.8.

SAPinsider’s ERP Migration and Transformation 2026 report found that 55% of organizations have deployed SAP S/4HANA or SAP cloud, but only 34% have fully transitioned, meaning the majority are running mixed estates where these classic components still carry critical business processes and must be patched on the same cadence as newer components.
